title: Ravin of Garash
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In Gittin 89b, he treated Rav Ashi’s daughter, and she was healed.[^1][^2]

notes.text: Hyman cites Gittin 89b and calls him Ravin of Garash. The episode in [Gittin 69b](https://www.sefaria.org/Gittin.69b.7) names Ravin of Naresh and says that Rav Ashi’s daughter recovered after his treatment.
[Heilprin likewise cites 69b and calls him Ravin of Naresh](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=183&lang=en). The source of Hyman’s different spelling and folio remains uncertain.
